files.exact_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create deck candidate A, a new 1536x1536 RGBA transparent Persona 3 Reload menu illustration of Makoto Yuki. Image 1 is the identity and drawing-style reference; image 2 is pose/composition reference ONLY, exclude its UI, text and background. Flat two-tone cel artwork: pure white and pale cyan-white lights, saturated cobalt/ultramarine shadows, deep navy darkest shapes, crisp black hard ink outlines. No gradients, realistic lighting or glow. Navy hair with cyan highlight blocks covering his right eye; black school jacket, white shirt, thin black ribbon tie, red headphones at neck and red left armband, headphone cable; red only on headphones and armband. HUGE sideways face close-up: head reclined about 70 degrees toward image right, lying in LEFT half and looking toward right/viewer, calm slightly tired expression with one large clearly visible open eye. One hand with five natural fingers and short cuff gently rests on forehead hair. Face/hair bleed beyond LEFT, TOP and BOTTOM edges. Right edge of figure is clean hair/shirt collar silhouette with actual transparent space beyond it. Hair tips float toward upper right, distinct pointed strands. No card, no text, watermark, signature, UI, background, water, bubbles, halo or border. Genuine alpha=0 background. Match reference character and flat ink/cel language.
files.issues: 第一轮 A；用户反馈脸不像结城理，不能选作 base。

files.exact_prompt: Create candidate C, Persona 3 Reload DECK menu portrait, canvas EXACT 1536x1536 RGBA with genuine transparent background. Image 1 is Makoto Yuki identity and flat cel ink style reference; image 2 is pose reference, mirrored horizontally. Draw SAME face, not a generic cute anime boy: slender elongated face, narrow tapered jaw, small pointed chin, delicate straight nose, small closed short neutral mouth, a narrow horizontally long almond-shaped cool blue-grey visible eye with heavy relaxed upper lid, slightly tired detached expression. NO round wide doll eyes, no round cheeks, no smile. Asymmetric navy hair covers his right eye, cyan hard highlight blocks. IMPORTANT HEAD NEARLY HORIZONTAL: rotate upright head 70 degrees clockwise so forehead lies to LEFT and chin points RIGHT. Extreme giant face close-up cropped by top left bottom; silhouette on right with transparent area outside. One natural five-fingered hand and short school-uniform cuff rests on forehead. Hair trails upper right. Black school blazer, white collar, thin black ribbon tie; red headphones at neck, red left armband if in frame; headphone cord. White/pale cyan lights, cobalt/ultramarine darks, navy deep shadow, black clean ink. STRICT flat solid cel color shapes, no gradient, glow, texture or realistic shading. No text, water, bubbles, UI, backdrop, halo, border or card. Character likeness must remain Makoto Yuki as in reference 1.

files.exact_prompt: EDIT the supplied portrait. Keep exact Makoto Yuki identity, narrow sleepy blue-grey eye and clean flat white/cobalt/navy ink style. TRANSFORM COMPOSITION radically: rotate the entire character CLOCKWISE approximately 90 degrees relative to the supplied image. His head must now LIE ON ITS SIDE, forehead and crown at the LEFT, CHIN and COLLAR at the RIGHT. The long axis from forehead to chin is almost HORIZONTAL, sloping down just 20 degrees from left to right. This is a sideways sleeping portrait, not an upright head tilt. Enlarge face massively until top, left and bottom hair/cheek are cut off by canvas. Keep only the huge sideways face, the one hand resting lightly on forehead (all five fingers natural) and a little collar; most torso should be outside canvas. Hair streams up-right with clear tips. Right silhouette has transparent space outside it. Neutral short straight closed mouth, no smile; one calm narrow eye looking at viewer, bangs cover right eye. RGBA transparent background, 1536x1536 square. No background, water, UI, letters, text, glow, gradients, realistic shading, border. Preserve red neck headphones only if visible; no extra red.
